content: Glomulin is a protein encoded by the GLMN gene in humans. This protein is phosphorylated and functions as a component of a complex resembling the Skp1-Cullin-F-box complex. It plays a critical role in the normal development of the vascular system. Mutations in the GLMN gene are linked to glomuvenous malformations, also referred to as glomangiomas. Alternative splicing of this gene results in the production of different protein isoforms, although the complete structure of only one isoform has been fully characterized. The GLMN protein has been demonstrated to interact with FKBP52, C-Met, and FKBP1A.
